520:t_2:141.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We Spacenoids have always sought one thing throughout history: the establishment of self-rule.」

520:t_2:142.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is common to every parallel world, and in each of them the Earthnoids will never accept that demand.」

520:t_2:143.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This outcome is also what the $$クロノ$$ of each world intend, but...」

520:t_2:144.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Earthnoids know that the moment they recognize the rights of Spacenoids, the master and servant relationship will be reversed.」

520:t_2:145.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The reason is obvious. Space holds a future that the closed world called Earth does not.」

520:t_2:146.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Earthnoids who cling only to Earth will obviously reach their limits in energy, in food, and in economic activity itself.」

520:t_2:147.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Spacenoids, on the other hand, can sustain themselves well enough even if they cut themselves off from Earth... $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ should have made this very fact his weapon.」

520:t_2:149.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But although he was an excellent thinker, he was not a politician.」

520:t_2:150.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The same goes for the $$ザビ家$$, who twisted the ideals of $$ジオン$$ and used them for their war of independence, for the leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$, and for $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$.」

520:t_2:151.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Unless they give up the idea of making Earth recognize their existence, the Spacenoids' fight cannot be won.」

520:t_2:152.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You believe that you can bring about that victory?」

520:t_2:153.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If every colony concluded an economic agreement and shunned Earth, Earth would be reduced to a backwater with no economic value at all...」

520:t_2:154.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then Earth's system of rule would gradually collapse too... That is the construction of the Colony Co-Prosperity Sphere that I advocate.」

520:t_2:156.en:
$$シャア$$
「But that changed because of the $$新世時空震動$$ and the existence of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

520:t_2:157.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To me, that was a kind of revelation. I saw clearly what I had to do, and at that very time, you returned to $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:159.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「At the same time, $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, who saw the reorganization of society as an opportunity, offered to hand over $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

520:t_2:160.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Whatever it might be, I judged that if it could shake the Federation, it would benefit my plan.」

520:t_2:161.en:
$$シャア$$
「And now that you have submitted to the $$サイデリアル$$, what then?」

520:t_2:162.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Seizing the Box has become a sort of game, but its usefulness is still intact.」

520:t_2:163.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As for the Colony Co-Prosperity Sphere, now that the Empire has annihilated the $$地球連邦$$, the plan has become all the more realistic.」

520:t_2:164.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So we hand Earth over to the Empire, and the colonies walk their own path.」

520:t_2:165.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Not that I intend to let invaders run rampant on our mother planet forever.」

520:t_2:166.en:
$$シン$$
「Are you thinking of fighting the Empire?」

520:t_2:167.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「However, that fight will look different from the kind you imagine.」

520:t_2:168.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That move is already in motion.」

520:t_2:169.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You don't feel like telling us about it?」

520:t_2:170.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Not unless you all swear to become my allies.」

520:t_2:171.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There is no need for that.」

520:t_2:173.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean my plan is not even worth considering?」

520:t_2:174.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Now that I've heard it, it is a petty tale. The way you grasp things is fundamentally incompatible with mine.」

520:t_2:175.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Building a Colony Co-Prosperity Sphere that shuns the Earthnoids... Rather than demand that those who won't change change, just ignore them. That is your idea...」

520:t_2:176.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It is far from the ideal of $$ジオン・ダイクン$$, who dreamed of the innovation of humanity. It is also far from the passion of $$シャア$$, who tried to protect all of Earth and space.」

520:t_2:178.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Are you fine with that? Even if the Empire's rule continues like this, there are people in the world who will keep fighting without giving up.」

520:t_2:179.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Their anger and hatred will be turned even on the Spacenoids who want no part in any of this.」

520:t_2:180.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「A future where the fighting goes on out of sheer hatred, with neither harmony nor innovation... No, such a thing cannot be called a future.」

520:t_2:181.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「A stagnant world where history repeats itself is no different from being inside the $$時の牢獄$$.」

520:t_2:182.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You mean to take the place of $$クロノ$$, but why can't you see that what you are doing is the same as those who never allow us to advance toward the future?」

520:t_2:183.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand how you feel, Princess. But this is not a question of right or wrong.」

520:t_2:184.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I merely put first the continuation of the human world... of the present.」

520:t_2:185.en:
$$シャア$$
「So you have no intention of continuing this talk any further...」

520:t_2:186.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A vessel does not think. It simply acts according to the collective will of the people poured into it, in order to keep all of humanity alive.」

520:t_2:187.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...It sounds like you're talking about someone else...」

520:t_2:188.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're talking about our future, yet your words feel coldly detached, as if it were somebody else's business.」

520:t_2:190.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$... You are a sad man who opens his heart to no one.」

520:t_2:191.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You want to say you are different, $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$?」

520:t_2:192.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「At the very least, I want to be that kind of person.」

520:t_2:193.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I was taught by a dear friend that the longing for the future gives birth to strength.」

520:t_2:195.en:
$$キラ$$
「A person who cannot connect hearts with others cannot save anyone.」

520:t_2:196.en:
$n
「Because it's somebody else's problem, you convince yourself you can move people's lives with armchair theory alone.」

520:t_2:197.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「And you mistake not fighting for peace.」

520:t_2:198.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A man like that has no right to talk about the future.」

520:t_2:199.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The continuation of the present is the future. I will simply protect it.」

520:t_2:200.en:
$$刹那$$
「Now I understand... Why you tried to accept the $$時の牢獄$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

520:t_2:201.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You... are not looking at the future at all.」

520:t_2:202.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You bastards...! Forgetting your place!」

520:t_2:203.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's all right, $$アンジェロ$$. Those who are about to become our comrades need to speak their true minds as well.」

520:t_2:204.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We have no intention of acknowledging you.」

520:t_2:205.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What we want is tomorrow! We're fighting so that tomorrow will be even a little better than today!」

520:t_2:206.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even if where it leads is despair?」

520:t_2:207.en:
$$シャア$$
「As I thought, you too saw the vision of a despairing future as a $$特異点$$.」

520:t_2:208.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Having seen that, you can still find hope. That is what I cannot believe about you.」

520:t_2:209.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But you must have felt it too. That light that enveloped $$アクシズ$$.」

520:t_2:210.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It was warm... It felt as if the feelings of everyone I know had come together...」

520:t_2:211.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If people have such a possibility, it has to become the power to change the present.」

520:t_2:212.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even so, people do not change. $$クロノ$$ still schemes in the shadows, and the Captain could not cast off his hatred.」

520:t_2:215.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...People do not change even when shown a possibility. To preserve the status quo, they bury even possibility. That is what humans are.」

520:t_2:216.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We have no choice but to seek peace and stability within that reality. You would do well to realize that the possibility you speak of can also become a poison that causes strife.」

520:t_2:217.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As I thought, you are not $$シャア$$...」

520:t_2:218.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If I lack the charisma to lead people as he did, then that role must fall to you, Princess.」

520:t_2:219.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You set up a decoy, and now you mean to drag me out?」

520:t_2:220.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will make use of $$ハマーン$$'s defection. That girl was prepared by her as her own puppet, and we had no choice but to obey...」
